metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2017 · It
metas.description: In the summer of 1989, a group of bullied kids band together to destroy a shape-shifting monster, which disguises itself as a clown and preys on the children of Derry, their small Maine town.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2018 · A Quiet Place
metas.description: A family struggles for survival in a world invaded by blind alien creatures with ultra-sensitive hearing.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2016 · Split
metas.description: Three girls are kidnapped by a man with a diagnosed 23 distinct personalities. They must try to escape before the apparent emergence of a frightful new 24th.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2019 · Midsommar
metas.description: A couple travels to Northern Europe to visit a rural hometown's fabled Swedish mid-summer festival. What begins as an idyllic retreat quickly devolves into an increasingly violent and bizarre competition at the hands of a pagan cult.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2018 · Hereditary
metas.description: A grieving family is haunted by tragic and disturbing occurrences.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2016 · 10 Cloverfield Lane
metas.description: A young woman is held in an underground bunker by a man who insists that a hostile event has left the surface of the Earth uninhabitable.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2016 · The Witch
metas.description: An isolated Puritan family in 1630s New England comes unraveled by the forces of witchcraft and possession.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2016 · The Conjuring 2
metas.description: Ed and Lorraine Warren travel to North London to help a single mother raising four children alone in a house plagued by a supernatural spirit.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2016 · Don't Breathe
metas.description: Three delinquents break into the house of a war veteran who is blind to steal his money. However, they discover that the man is not as defenseless as he seems.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2019 · The Platform
metas.description: In a prison where inmates are fed on a descending platform, those on the upper levels take more than their fair share while those below are left to starve on scraps and one man decides to change the system.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2019 · The Lighthouse
metas.description: Two lighthouse keepers try to maintain their sanity while living on a remote and mysterious New England island in the 1890s.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 2019 · Doctor Sleep
metas.description: Years following the events of The Shining (1980), a now-adult Dan Torrance must protect a young girl with similar powers from a cult known as The True Knot, who prey on children with powers to remain immortal.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2017 · The Killing of a Sacred Deer
metas.description: A devious teen starts to insinuate himself into the life of a renowned surgeon and his family.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2015 · Bone Tomahawk
metas.description: In the Old West, a small-town sheriff and his rag-tag posse set out to rescue several townspeople from a brutal cave-dwelling, cannibalistic Indian tribe.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2016 · The Wailing
metas.description: Soon after a stranger arrives in a little village, a mysterious sickness starts spreading. A policeman, drawn into the incident, is forced to solve the mystery in order to save his daughter...

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2018 · Stree
metas.description: In the small town of Chanderi, the menfolk live in fear of an evil spirit named "Stree" who abducts men in the night. Based on the urban legend of "Nale Ba" that went viral in Karnataka in the 1990s.
